**STEP 1 - Scene:** A small snack of whole almonds (roasted or raw-looking, brown skins) sitting in a pile on a white plate.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A white square-ish side plate, about 20 cm across. Area = 3.14 × (10)² ≈ 314 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** Whole almonds (about 30 nuts). No oil, dressing, or sauce is visible.

**STEP 4 - Area:** The almond pile covers roughly 13% of the plate (about 41 cm²).

**STEP 5 - Volume:** The pile is about one almond thick, so the average height is roughly 1.1 cm. Volume ≈ 41 × 1.1 ≈ 45 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Nuts pack loosely, so I use a bulk density of about 0.6 g/ml. Weight ≈ 45 × 0.6 ≈ 27 g. Counting about 30 almonds at roughly 1.2 g each gives about 35 g, so I settle on about 30 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Almonds are about 580 kcal/100 g. 30 g × 5.8 ≈ 174 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 30 almonds on a 20 cm plate is a plausible small snack. Thirty grams and about 175 kcal fit a small handful of nuts.
